comparison.objective: Deploy a bicycle side stand and leave the bicycle clear of the wall; unlike shock-absorber adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-object stabilization, stand deployment, and balance transfer versus small-tool manipulation and iterative damping calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Title requires stable side-stand support without wall contact; body, clearance, stability duration, damage rules, and all specs are missing.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is balance and support transition, not adjustment and locking of a damper.
